name: Marching Cubes 33
definition: An algorithm for constructing isosurfaces from volumetric datasets on a cuberille grid. It processes each cell independently to produce a triangle model whose topology coincides exactly with the topology of the trilinear function defining the isosurface, resolving the topological ambiguities present in the original 15-configuration Marching Cubes method.
summary: Marching Cubes 33 is a topologically correct isosurface algorithm that resolves ambiguities in the original method using an expanded 33-entry lookup table based on analytical connectivity tests.
